executors.description: Read mapped steel-market indicators from the configured local MySQL database.

actions.description: Inspect the configured database tables and columns without exposing credentials or sample data.
actions.result: A safe schema overview used to configure the two-table mapping.

actions.description: Inspect mapped fields and optionally resolve a natural-language request against bounded exact catalog values before discovery.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Optional original request. Returns exact catalog-backed field matches and indicator-name terms; it does not infer synonyms or select an indicator.

actions.result: A bounded catalog profile and, when query is supplied, auditable suggested discovery filters.

actions.description: Find candidates when the owner analysis plan needs explicit catalog inspection or multiple candidates. Use confirmed province/city/county/region, product, metric, producer, source, market and name fields; conditions are ANDed and fields are never interchangeable.

inputs.name: filters-json
inputs.description: JSON with confirmed fields, e.g. city_name, breed_name, metric_name, producer_name or indicator_name. Start with stable dimensions. If a field returns zero candidates, omit it and use an indicator_name token, then verify the full name. Samples and null fields do not prove absence.

actions.result: Bounded, non-aggregated indicator candidates with their matched dimensions.

actions.description: For a multi-date request, locate one exact mapped indicator and immediately query its INDEX_CODE-bound raw observations. A one-date request must use locate-day.

inputs.name: filters-json
inputs.description: Catalog-backed fields from preflight queryUnderstanding, including an indicator_name term when a grade is only present in the display name.

inputs.name: start-date
inputs.description: Inclusive ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.

inputs.name: end-date
inputs.description: Inclusive ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.result: One exact candidate plus a standard query-series raw JSON artifact (acquisitionAction=locate-series) that can be passed directly to steel-market-analysis analyze-series, or truthful empty/ambiguous candidate evidence without querying observations.

actions.description: For one calendar date, locate one exact mapped indicator and return that date's complete raw observation set without choosing a representative price.

inputs.name: filters-json
inputs.description: Catalog-backed fields from preflight queryUnderstanding. Conditions identify one catalog candidate before any value-table read.

inputs.name: date
inputs.description: The one ISO observation date, YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.result: One exact candidate plus agentloop.steelMarketDayEvidence/v1. Same-day multiple raw values remain separate observations.

actions.description: Optional acquisition primitive after the owner analysis plan has selected one bounded, uniquely resolvable series. It atomically preflights exact mapped values, locates one INDEX_CODE and retrieves raw observations; it is not an analysis method or a default route.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: The complete original request used only for bounded exact matching against mapped catalog values.

inputs.name: start-date
inputs.description: Inclusive ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.

inputs.name: end-date
inputs.description: Inclusive ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.result: A standard query-series raw JSON artifact with catalogPreflight and acquisitionAction=resolve-and-locate-series, or truthful unresolved candidate evidence without reading observations.

actions.description: For one date, atomically preflight exact catalog values, locate one indicator, and return that date's raw observation set. It never invents an INDEX_CODE or a representative price.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: The complete original request used only for bounded exact matching against mapped catalog values.

inputs.name: date
inputs.description: The one ISO observation date, YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.result: An agentloop.steelMarketDayEvidence/v1 raw-day artifact with catalog preflight evidence, or truthful unresolved candidate evidence.

actions.description: Execute the upper analysis Skill's bounded data-selection plan. Equal start/end dates use the raw-day path; multi-date windows use raw-series. A direct INDEX_CODE must carry the catalog-issued selectionToken.

inputs.name: plan-file
inputs.description: Absolute Run-workspace path to agentloop.steelMarketQueryPlan/v1. Each direct indicatorId must include its catalog-issued selectionToken; filters remain an alternative selector.

actions.result: Independently retained raw query batches, each preserving its exact selection receipt, plus an aggregate receipt identifying unresolved plan items. Pass the complete execution result to steel-market-analysis analyze-series.

actions.description: Legacy one-keyword lookup against the stored INDEX_NAME only. It cannot create or infer a metric name.

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.description: A keyword from an indicator name that actually exists in the catalog.

actions.result: Matching indicator candidates and their configured dimensions.

actions.description: Retrieve a multi-date raw series only for an INDEX_CODE accompanied by the opaque token issued with one exact catalog candidate.

inputs.name: indicator-id
inputs.description: Exact INDEX_CODE from the preceding unique catalog result.

inputs.name: selection-token
inputs.description: Opaque selectionToken returned with that exact candidate; it cannot be invented or substituted.

inputs.name: start-date
inputs.description: Inclusive ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD; it must precede end-date.

inputs.name: end-date
inputs.description: Inclusive ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD; it must follow start-date.

actions.result: A parameterized, capped exact-indicator multi-date series plus a database evidence receipt.

actions.description: Retrieve one date's complete raw observation set only for an INDEX_CODE accompanied by its catalog-issued selectionToken.

inputs.name: indicator-id
inputs.description: Exact INDEX_CODE from the preceding unique catalog result.

inputs.name: selection-token
inputs.description: Opaque selectionToken returned with that exact candidate.

inputs.name: date
inputs.description: The one ISO observation date, YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.result: A parameterized exact-indicator raw-day result plus agentloop.steelMarketDayEvidence/v1; it does not choose a daily representative price.
